scams.name: Fake Police Check
scams.avoidance: Ask to see proper ID and write down their badge numbers Offer to go with them to the nearest police station instead Real Danish police will never demand to see your cash on the street
scams.location: Streets near Design Museum, tourist areas

scams.name: Train Ticket Charity Scam
scams.avoidance: Don't purchase tickets for strangers at stations If you want to help someone in need, direct them to Copenhagen social services Keep your distance from people hovering at ticket machines

scams.name: Strøget Pickpocketing
scams.avoidance: Keep valuables in front pockets or a secure crossbody bag Be extra vigilant during crowded summer months Avoid displaying expensive cameras or jewelry on Strøget

scams.name: Overpaying for Transit Without Rejsekort
scams.avoidance: Buy an anonymous Rejsekort travel card at any 7-Eleven or DSB station The card pays for itself within 2-3 days of regular use Return the card before you leave for a partial refund of the deposit
scams.location: All Copenhagen transit — Metro, S-tog, buses

scams.name: Nyhavn Restaurant Overcharging
scams.avoidance: Walk one block back from Nyhavn to find restaurants with locals inside Look at full menus with prices before sitting anywhere near the canal Most Copenhagen restaurants add 'bread' charges automatically — ask if it's included

scams.name: Fake Photo Opportunity Scam
scams.avoidance: Ask other tourists to take your photo instead of strangers Use a selfie stick for important shots If you hand your phone to someone, stand close enough to grab it back easily
